t:
What was the purpose of the Steam Boiler Assurance Company?

I. Inspection and revision of steam engines and boilers
II. Providing insurance coverage to steam engines and boilers
III. Maintenance of steam engines and boilers
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following will not be classified as 'Mine' as per the definition of mine under the Mine Act 1952?

I. All conveyors or aerial ropeways used in mine
II. All power stations for supplying electricity solely for the purpose of working the mine
III. Premises, where ten or more workers are working, in any part of which a manufacturing process is being carried on with or without the aid of power
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: At the time of indemnification all costs of alterations, additions, improvements are also borne by the insurer. Debate. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: All costs of alterations, additions, improvements are to be borne by the insured
No additions or improvements are allowed at the ti
e: Correct answer: All costs of alterations, additions, improvements are to be borne by the insured (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The construction phase insurances are also known as _____________.
e: Correct answer: Project Insurances (from the IC77 question bank).

t: All policies issued in the Engineering department are on ________ basis except those issued for major projects.
e: Correct answer: Annual (from the IC77 question bank).

t: CAR policy provides virtually a comprehensive cover for the entire civil engineering projects from the time of arrival of the first lot of materials at site and till the _____________.
o: One year from start of policy
Two years from start of policy
Three years from start of policy
e: Correct answer: Site maintenance (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which of the following plant, machinery or equipment is primarily used for conveying liquids and / gases from one machine to another or from one place to another?
o: Engines such as steam, gas, diesel or petrol engin
e: Correct answer: Pumps (from the IC77 question bank).

t: What is the minimum capacity of a vessel to be termed as a boiler under the Indian Boilers Act 1923?
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: 22.75 litres (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Device a term to describe the amount mentioned in the policy, which is to be borne by the insured in respect of each and every claim.
e: Correct answer: Excess (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following come in the ambit of engineering insurance?

I. Petro chemical plants
II. Satellites
III. Offshore platforms
e: Correct answer: ONLY I (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which of the below statement is correct with regards to construction annual policies (floaters)?
o: They are issued on individual declaration basis or turnover basis
They are issued on group declaration basis or turn
They are issued on group declaration basis or perc
They are issued on group declaration basis
e: Correct answer: They are issued on individual declaration basis or turnover basis (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Under predictive maintenance, which analysis is suitable for analysisng motors, alternators, insulation, brickwork of boilers?
e: Correct answer: Infrared thermal analysis (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Testing operations can be divided into how many categories?
e: Correct answer: Two (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following types of expenditures are covered under the delay in start-up section of a CPI Policy?

I. Express deliveries
II. Air freight
III. Overtime
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are the advantages of an insurance company providing inspection services along with engineering insurance?

I. Assess risk from underwriting angle
II. Recommend loss minimisation
III. Risk improvement measures
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following losses are excluded from the scope of a MLOP Policy?

I. Spoilage of materials
II. Improvement expenses
III. Overhaul expenses to damaged property
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a 'Hydrocarbon Endorsement For Testing & Commissioning' -Article 1, in any operation where hydrocarbons or hydrogen are involved the deductible excess shall be 5% of claim amount subject to minimum of _______.
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: Rs5,00,000 (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a deterioration of stock (Potatoes) in cold storage insurance policy, how is the value of the potatoes at the time of commencement of the insurance determined?
o: Mutually agreed upon between the insured and the insurance company
Average price of potatoes in last 3 months period
Average price of potatoes in last 6 months period
e: Correct answer: Mutually agreed upon between the insured and the insurance company (from the IC77 question bank).

t: ____________ refers to the amount of money (less discounts allowed) paid or payable to the Insured for goods, products or services sold, delivered or rendered in the course of the insured business conducted at the premises.
e: Correct answer: Turnover (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Identify the reinsurance arrangement which is very much necessary to protect the net account of the insurance company in the event of catastrophic losses.
e: Correct answer: Excess of loss treaty (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Five sets of endorsement wordings are available from the London Market for the Defect Exclusion (D.E.). Which set pertains to DE5?
e: Correct answer: Design improvement exclusion (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
When does the period of insurance under a ALOP Policy terminates?

I. End of one year from issue of policy
II. Commencement of commercial operations
III. Completion of substantial construction
o: I or II whichever is earlier
II or III whichever is earlier
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The package of which two policies together is often termed as DOS Insurance?

I. Only Machinery Insurance policy
II. Loss of Profit
III. Losses due to machinery breakdown IV. Machinery damage and damage to stocks in lieu of the same
e: Correct answer: IV (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are examples of operational phase policies?

I. Machinery Insurance (MI)
II. Civil Engineering Completed Risks (CECR)
III. Machinery Loss of Profits
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Prakash Industries has a bulb manufacturing factory. It has taken a machinery insurance policy for its machines. The owner wants to know which of the following losses shall not be covered under the policy?

I. Theft of machinery parts from the factory
II. Damage of machinery due to collision of machines during shifting within premises
III. Damage of machinery due to over heating
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Contractor's plant and machinery insurance protects the contractor from which of the following perils?

I. Fire
II. Human error
III. Storm
e: Correct answer: I  II & III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which of the following plant and machinery shall not be classified under mobile machinery?
e: Correct answer: Fixed conveyor systems (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In an Erection All Risk (EAR) Insurance Policy, the provisions related to third party liability are covered under ___________.
e: Correct answer: Section II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In the Indian context, 10% of all direct Indian Engineering business, subject to a certain limit, is obligatorily ceded by all the Indian insurance companies to the ___________.
e: ★ Key fact (repeated across the mocks of this paper). Correct answer: GIC (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following costs shall be indemnified in case of a damage to the insured property?

I. Freight
II. Costs of dismantling
III. Cost of rectifying faults occurred without a claims event
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The financial consequences of any delay in commissioning of a plant under construction may relate to:

I. Liquidity
II. Growth
III. Standing charges during the period of delay in commissioning of the plant / production facility
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In boiler and pressure plant insurance policy, the basic rates of premium depend upon:

I. Type of boiler
II. Type of fuel
III. Contractor
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are not examples of of operational phase policies?

I. Contractor's All Risks (CAR) insurance
II. Erection All Risks (EAR) insurance
III. Electronic Equipment insurance
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Arrange the stages of risk management in proper sequence starting from first to last.

I. Risk financing
II. Risk identification
III. Risk control
e: Correct answer: II, III and I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The boiler and pressure plant insurance policy covers insured boilers and pressure vessels against the risk of:

I. Explosion
II. Collapse
III. Damage by fire
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a EAR and MCE policy, containing endorsements for test run definition in respect of thermal power station, till what date is the power station machinery insured are deemed to continue their first test operation of test loading?
o: Till the date of   synchronisation of the Turbo Ge
Till the date of introduction of steam into turbin
Till the date Turbo Generator  Set is operated at
Till the Turbo Generator  Set is operated at full load for a continuous period of 72 hours or until expiry of  testing period granted under the policy  which ever is earlier
e: Correct answer: Till the Turbo Generator  Set is operated at full load for a continuous period of 72 hours or until expiry of  testing period granted under the policy  which ever is earlier (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are examples of construction phase policies?

I. Erection All Risks (EAR)
II. Boiler and Pressure Plant insurance (BPP)
III. Civil Engineering Completed Risks (CECR) insurance
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t: A corporate agent may tie up with a maximum of how many insurers in each line of business?
e: ★ Core fact (asked across III papers). Raised from 3 to 9 insurers per category (life, general, health) by the 2022 amendment to the Corporate Agents Regulations.

t:
Which of the following factors determine the rates and terms of a CPM Policy?

I. Maintenance and upkeep system
II. Origin of machinery - local or imported
III. Working environment on site
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following damages and losses are exceptions to a machinery insurance policy?

I. Physical damage to the machinery due to experiments
II. Physical damage due to mallignment
III. Damage due to lack od skill
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Explain the primary objective of ALOP insurance.
o: To indemnify the project owner for actual loss sustained due to a delay in commencement of commercial operations of a new project under progress
To indemnify the contractors for actual loss susta
To indemnify the suppliers for actual loss sustain
To indemnify the sub-contractors for actual loss s
To indemnify the project owners and contractors bo
e: Correct answer: To indemnify the project owner for actual loss sustained due to a delay in commencement of commercial operations of a new project under progress (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
XYZ Ltd. has taken a MLOP insurance. The company wants to know as to when does the indemnity period terminate in case the policy is exercised? Advise.

I. End of one year from issue of policy
II. Production reaches normal level existing at the time of the occurrence of the insured peril
III. Expiry of the number of months selected by the insured
o: I or II whichever is earlier
II or III whichever is earlier
e: Correct answer: II or III whichever is earlier (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a machinery insurance, if the insured item is totally destroyed or is a constructive total loss, the basis of indemnification is _____________.
o: Market value of the item immediately before the accident plus cost of removing the damaged machinery less value of salvage
Depreciated value of the item immediately before t
Original Cost of the item plus cost of removing th
e: Correct answer: Market value of the item immediately before the accident plus cost of removing the damaged machinery less value of salvage (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The obligatory cession that Indian general insurers must make to GIC Re is currently:
e: ★ Core fact (asked across III papers). The obligatory cession was reduced to 4% from 1 April 2022.

t:
From the option given below, suggest the correct use of pumps.

I. They used for conveying liquids and gases from one machine to another
II. For storage of steam, liquids and gases under pressure
III. They are used for movement of materials, men and machines
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which Act in the UK provides for compulsory inspection of steam boilers in factories to be thoroughly inspected once in 14 months by a competent person?

I. The Factory and Workshop Act 1901
II. The Boiler Explosion Act 1882
III. The Coal Mines Act of 1911
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which among the following will come under the definition of mines under the Mines Act 1952?

I. Boring
II. Oil wells
III. Conveyors used in mines
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which among the following are principles applicable to all classes of engineering insurance?

I. Utmost good faith
II. Indemnity
III. Proximate cause
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Any cost incurred to the equipment while being moved outside India shall be covered in the Electronic Equipment Insurance Policy. Debate. Choose the most appropriate answer.
o: Cost of time involved in moving the equipment outs
All costs incurred and damages occurred while movi
e: Correct answer: This statement is wrong (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the examples of general exclusions in Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance policy.

I. Loss discovered at the time of taking inventory
II. Loss or damage due to tempest
III. Loss due to total or partial immersion in tidal water
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC77 question bank).
